parsed.internal_thinking: Charlie is at 3 VP and has 2 revealed knights. One more knight gives him Largest Army and 5 VP (the win). My priority is to block his Ore production to prevent him from buying more Dev cards. Hex 17 is Ore 5 and is only occupied by Charlie (Node 41). This is the most surgical strike to stop the win. Hex 14 is Wheat 9 (Charlie and Bob), but Ore is the critical bottleneck for the knight Charlie needs. Hex 11 (Ore 3) also hits me, so Hex 17 is the optimal choice.
